parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. The ID can be up to 64 characters long and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud transcoding job. The ID can be up to 64 characters long and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
